notes: Read SKILL.md, references/details.md and references/advanced-strategies.md in full. The skill helps design multi-stage CI/CD pipelines: approval gates (GitHub Actions environments, GitLab manual/delayed jobs, Azure ManualValidation), rolling/blue-green/canary (Argo Rollouts) strategies, deep health checks, rollback, DORA metrics, expand/contract migrations, freeze windows and Slack notifications.

The output is pipeline configuration and scripts the agent writes into the user's repository; kubectl apply/patch/rollout undo, docker push, flyway and curl-to-webhook commands appear inside those pipeline definitions and runbook examples, gated by environment protection rules or `when: manual` (production deploy and `kubectl delete namespace staging` at advanced-strategies.md:226-227). The skill does not tell the agent to run deployments itself, and all hosts, account IDs (123456789) and webhooks are placeholders.
